label: Power premises of the route with Pruss's own premise: transfer, two-way giving, Pruss's direction
summary:
#1887 slice 2 (warrant of the power premises of the route with Pruss's own premise, 42da6b2d); note docs/notes/pruss-power-premises.md. Analyst formulations; read 2026-11-23 for navigation: ST I q.104 a.3 co., ad 1, ad 3 (newadvent.org/summa/1104.htm); Met. Theta 2 1046b and Theta 5 1048a, Ross (classics.mit.edu); Pruss, 'The Actual and the Possible', sections 'An Aristotelian alternative' and 'A combined account'. One-way and two-way giving are typed extensionally on the frame's GivesAt (DEFs 62dfa893, 7bc1d667, bd4c434d, e006ddeb). Q1: P1-prime needs the collective reading (varying-holder distributive grounding holds with no necessary being, MutualAnnihilators; the one-present-holder reading suffices without P4-prime, law 8: C1's lesson of 197f0097; distinct from the one-holder POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 reading eb41bc9a, which gives necessity only at a foundational being, law 9). The transfer to POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over each member is not valid as typed (CollectiveWithoutDistributive: replacement on the thin reading of PowerFor; formally PowerOver is unconstrained; one actual contingent, so collective and distributive coincide there and the separation shown is PowerFor to POWER_OVER_ESSE_1, already for one member; TwoMemberCollective, result 9bba1325, separates the whole-to-member step at the level of PowerFor). For the global target the abstention claim of bf7eddca holds on both readings; the thin/causal split concerns the actual-indexed target only. Ad 1 shows the absence is never the holder's direct effect, so a stated bridge is needed; with its continuation and ad 3 (absence caused only indirectly, by withdrawing a giving) it does not support replacement as the Thomist reading (PowerFor DEF bf7eddca's note amended accordingly). Its conclusion eb41bc9a has a second support from the creator reading 9f7b1778, factive giving 3ef41442 and the withheld-giving bridge d1593e5c (56024b0c, 84cc194c); either support gives PGP's verdict at C2's foundational being c5da5e62 (2cc7e260 to b19ffd92), relocating, not corroborating, the C2 crux. Q2: P2-delta's added clause is the denial of fixed giving at one world, so it carries exactly the anti-fixed-exercise content: law 1 and the varying conjunct of 4ce57995 (to 256a5e0a; only necessity is derived) are its direct instantiation, and without P2-delta an inert fixed g holds P1-prime's power (Omission 1). Its warrant is either the creator reading (law 5, shared with the PGP link) or the prima facie principle that exercise over existence shows in giving (excluding mediated or preventive exercise). b1f6a376's bundle is 42da6b2d's with P2-prime strengthened, adding no warrant for b90ee2de. Under the creator reading the joint absence is withholding and the holder's giving has a two-way (withholding) exercise profile (law 6); whether the power for q and the giving are one Theta 2-type potency is untyped (Theta 5 act-or-refrain; Theta 2 analogy only). Collapse: a necessary fixed giver's effects are necessary, so a necessary fixed-output (deterministic) source of all actual contingents removes P5, not P4-prime, which holds vacuously given an accessible world (laws 3-4); a chancy necessary source is not covered. Q3: inert necessary being fails P1-prime given P2-delta; necessary fixed-output source fails P5; positive-outcome-only powers fail P1-prime but ground Pruss's direction (6eb4d324, needing only symmetric access of S5, projected by 95078e7b), which avoids a power for a negative state but not the abstention fact (law 7). Provisional judgment, conditional on one of P2-delta's two warrants (with EM, P1-prime, P3-prime, P4-prime, P5, and P2-prime for the creator branch): the holder is a necessary being whose giving varies, not a one-way source, and under the creator branch its giving has a two-way (withholding) exercise profile; a candidate input to stage two (plan). Not supported: the bare transfer, the P2-delta-free one-way exclusion, choice rather than chance, independent corroboration of PGP. Repaired after the independent semantic challenge of head 303f6762 (4 P1, 8 P2, prose and records; one model strengthened: the replacement holder has power over the replacement's esse).

Curation pass 2, lane D (#2103, 2026-11-27). 8ad1804e tests f0ac2f76. Omit the transfer to power over each member's esse on the thin PowerFor reading. In replacementG, c is the only contingent concretum at the origin false. The thin reading counts g's giving d being at accessible true as power for the roster's absence because c is absent there. The giving does no causal work in c's absence. The independent, world-unindexed PowerOver assignment grants g power over d's esse and withholds it for c. 8ad1804e tests 5cf75a6b. Omit the exercise-difference premise. In inertG at false, g is a concrete, necessarily present holder of the actual-roster absence power. The giving relation is empty at both worlds, so the necessary varying-giver conclusion fails despite the other premises. 8ad1804e tests 9f7b1778. Omit the creator/conserver requirement that a holder give being at the origin false to every concretum contingent there. On the thin PowerFor reading, g's giving d being at accessible true counts as power for the roster's absence because c is absent there. The giving does no causal work in c's absence, and g never gives c being. Factive giving and the other premises hold on this reading, while withholding fails. 8ad1804e tests 3ef41442. Omit factivity of giving. In nonFactiveG with origin false, g is recorded as giving c being at both worlds. At true c is absent, yet the giving record remains. The other premises hold and the joint absence lacks the required withholding witness. 8ad1804e tests d1593e5c. Omit the bridge from withheld giving to power over esse. In theistG at false, g gives c being there and withholds it at true. No esse powers are assigned, so the bridge and the distributive conclusion fail. 8ad1804e tests 938650b0. Omit symmetry of access in the route from an absence world back to the origin. In forwardG, false accesses true, where the actual contingent c is absent, but true accesses only itself. With no powers assigned the absence-world clauses hold vacuously and no holder of the actuality power exists. 8ad1804e tests 607e94cf. Omit grounding at the absence worlds for the origin's obtaining. In theistG with no powers, the worlds access each other and c is absent at true. Initiator presence and holder concreteness there hold vacuously, while the actuality power is absent. 8ad1804e tests 9c8e99e7. Omit initiator presence at the absence worlds. In absentHolderG at origin false, g exists at true where it holds a power for false obtaining, yet g is absent at false. Grounding and the other nonlogical premises hold, and the required actual holder fails. 8ad1804e tests 887d5efc. Omit concreteness of the holder at the absence worlds. In theistG with only c and d concrete, g alone holds the power from the absence world and is present at both worlds. It fails the concrete holder requirement. 8ad1804e tests 18e5bd4e. Omit joint absence from the route grounded at absence worlds. In vanCleveG at a, c and d are both present and contingent, but every accessible world keeps one of them. The absence-world rules hold vacuously, and the conclusion requiring an accessible joint absence fails. 8ad1804e tests 18ad47bf. In theistG at false, g exists and holds a power for the joint absence of the roster containing c. There is an accessible world omitting c, and the transfer assigns the same holder g power over c's esse. The four premises hold together. 8ad1804e retains a nonlogical witness for 61e207fc. The whole-argument link to 61e207fc from #2116 was removed. TheistNonvacuity does not certify ExcludedMiddle over arbitrary propositions. In theistG at false, c is a contingent concretum and absent at true. The present concrete holder g gives c being at false and has a different giving pattern at true. Grounding, exercise difference, holder concreteness and both possibility and population conditions hold. 8ad1804e tests f872a512. In theistG g gives c being at false and is still present at the accessible world true, where c is absent and no giving occurs. The holder-to-recipient and factive-giving clauses hold jointly with the actual-roster absence premises. 8ad1804e tests 11afcb55. In theistG at false, g gives c being and withholds it at true. The actual-absence withholding predicate and the bridge to g's esse power over c hold jointly. 8ad1804e retains a nonlogical witness for 81b1b020. The whole-argument link to 81b1b020 from #2116 was removed. TheistNonvacuity does not certify ExcludedMiddle over arbitrary propositions. In theistG origin false and accessible absence world true are mutually accessible. Contingent c is present at false only. The same concrete g exists at both and has the power for false obtaining at true. The nonlogical premise bundle is jointly satisfied.
blocker: No premise is established. Open: the Theta 5 bridge from two-way giving to will (HAS_WILL_1, STMT-GOD-HAS-WILL 66aecdd7), blocked by the chance rival (propensity accounts; Pruss's own 'perhaps non-deterministic'); identification of the holder with GOD_4; the creator reading's warrant independent of the route; Pruss's aggregate holder; tensed withholding; intensional (single-potency) two-way powers; compatibility of varying extrinsic giving with #555's one-act simplicity reading; truth countermodel does not handle CausalityFrame parameters.

current_assessment.scope: The warrant of the power premises of the route with Pruss's own premise (42da6b2d): the grounding premise P1-prime 95bf8780, its exercise condition P2-delta 5cf75a6b, the transfer f0ac2f76 and the creator reading 9f7b1778, with the conclusions 256a5e0a, b8a2a9e1 and Pruss's own direction 1af99585.
current_assessment.assessment: Conditional on one of P2-delta's two warrants (the creator reading, shared with the PGP link, or the prima facie principle that exercise over existence shows in giving), and with EM, P1-prime, P3-prime, P4-prime, P5 (and P2-prime for the creator branch), the holder is a necessary being whose giving varies across worlds where it exists; under the creator branch its giving has a two-way (withholding) exercise profile. P2-delta carries exactly the anti-fixed-exercise content. The transfer spans two open gaps as typed: whole to member (TwoMemberCollective) and PowerFor to POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 (replacement, one member, thin reading). Its conclusion is also supported by the creator reading, which relocates rather than corroborates the C2 crux. Pruss's direction avoids a power for a negative state at the cost of grounding at a non-actual world and symmetric access, not the abstention fact. Not supported: the bare transfer, the P2-delta-free one-way exclusion, choice rather than chance.
current_assessment.next_test: The Theta 5 bridge from two-way giving to will against the chance rival (whether chance can be exercised by a patientless necessary being); the creator reading's warrant independent of the route; Pruss's aggregate holder.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent semantic challenge of 303f6762 (4 P1, 8 P2, all repaired) and its re-check of e3dfcd55 (all 12 resolved, no new P1; three P2s N1-N3 folded in). Acceptance covers the qualified, conditional synthesis only, not premise establishment.
